notes.title: Patch Notes v1.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the popcorn machine could be overfilled beyond its capacity.
[*] Fixed some achievements not working.
[*] Fixed the error in AM/PM time calculation.
[*] Fixed the unlimited upgrade issue for air conditioning and screen levels in cinema rooms.
[*] Fixed the cashier destroys 3D glasses.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The restocker can now use the boxes purchased by the player.
[*] The color of the caramel popcorn box has been darkened.
[*] The size of orders in the cash register UI has been reduced.
[*] A bug that caused excessive RAM usage when a movie started has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Shelf rotation bug fixed
notes.notes: The problem where shelves had incorrect rotations after saving and loading has been resolved

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where manual saving would take forever.
[*] Fixed the issue where fast forward would continue even without using the clock.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where letters couldn't be placed on walls.
[*] Added multithreaded saving support to prevent the game from freezing during autosave.
[*] Some adjustments have been made to prevent the game from freezing.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cashier couldn't deliver popcorn and drinks (Make sure there's empty space next to them to pick up the items).
[*] Removed the trash pickup time delay.
[*] NPCs now have a 30% chance to drop trash instead of 100%.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎬 Cinemaster Cinema Simulator is NOW AVAILABLE! 🍿✨

[h2][b]🎬Cinemaster Cinema Simulator is NOW AVAILABLE!🍿[/b][/h2]

[h3]The doors to your dream [b]cinema are officially open![/b] 🚪🎟️ It’s time to take control—set showtimes, sell tickets, and create the perfect movie experience for your audience. Choose the best films 🎞️, keep your theaters spotless 🧹, and make sure the popcorn is always fresh and ready to go! 🍿[/h3]

But running a cinema is more than just pressing play! ▶️ [b]You'll need to manage staff 👨‍💼, upgrade your equipment 🛠️, and keep customers happy 😊 with top-tier service[/b]. From vending machines 🥤 to VIP screenings 🎭, every decision you make will shape the future of your cinema empire.

[h3]Will you build a cozy indie theater 🎥 or a massive blockbuster multiplex? The choice is yours! Get ready to bring the magic of movies to life and become the ultimate Cinemaster! 🎬✨[/h3]

We’d love to hear your thoughts! [b]Share your feedback with us [/b]and help shape the future of Cinemaster Cinema Simulator. Your input is invaluable in making the game even better! 💬🎮

notes.title: 🎬 Lights, Camera… Action! Release on March 27, 2025! 🍿✨
notes.notes:
Movie lovers and sim fans, get ready—Cinemaster Cinema Simulator is coming your way! Ever dreamed of running your own movie theater? Now’s your chance to create the ultimate cinema empire, where every decision shapes the experience for your audience. From curating films to selling snacks, managing showtimes, and keeping your customers happy—you’re in charge!

[h3]Here’s what you can expect when the curtains rise:[/h3]

🎟️ Complete Cinema Management – Set showtimes, choose movies, and keep the seats filled!
 🍿 Concession Stand Madness – Pop popcorn, stock up on snacks, and keep those vending machines running.
 🛠️ Upgrade & Expand – Improve your theaters, hire staff, and turn your cinema into a must-visit entertainment hub.
 🎥 Realistic Movie Industry Simulation – Buy rights to films, monitor trends, and build a loyal customer base.
 🧹 Keep It Clean & Running Smoothly – No one likes a messy theater! Maintain your cinema to keep visitors happy.

[h3]🚀 Mark your calendars and [b]wishlist now[/b] to be among the first to step into the world of movie business mastery! The grand opening is just around the corner![/h3]

🔗 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327470/Cinemaster_Cinema_Simulator/

See you soon!
